summary: Genco Shipping & Trading Ltd filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Shareholders Rights Agreement (poison pill). The board eliminated the 'Acting in Concert' definition based on shareholder feedback while keeping other protective provisions intact. No price, premium, or share count is involved; this is a governance adjustment to an existing rights plan. The amendment remains defensive in nature without triggering any special situation. There are no deal terms, regulatory clocks, or risk-arb angles. The filing is a routine update to defensive measures, not an extraordinary corporate event.
